dedupe_keys.name: long term continuous monitoring of the dynamic response of the steel bridge

description: Long-term continuous monitoring of the dynamic response of the steel bridge is a data set deposited in igeg.asep by its authors Shota Urushadze, Stanislav Hračov. The dataset contains measurements obtained from strain gauges installed on the upper and lower flanges of the inner girder of the bridge superstructure. The data were collected during both short-term and long-term monitoring periods under normal traffic conditions dominated by heavy lorry crossings. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: JSON. Size stated: 21.4 MB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
